selection_policy: Every workflow touched by selected scope is returned deterministically. Unknown controlling facts remain needs_confirmation and may not be silently excluded.
quality_gates: Every workflow has an official source
Every workflow is reachable from supported project scope
Every conditional fact has a user-facing question
Every workflow has at least 10 substantive executable checks
Every required document has an executable evidence check
Every selected rule receives exactly one traceable result
No vector or LLM applicability filtering
